verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a campaigns API for drafting, scheduling and sending bulk marketing campaigns, plus abandoned-cart and booking-triggered automations. Nothing shows a one-to-one transactional send endpoint for receipts, magic links or notifications. Automation triggers are an adjacent feature, not direct API transactional sending.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
